title: 查看工作区摘要
content:
先确认当前工作区根路径，以及有限深度内大概有多少文件和目录。

输入参数：
{
  "mode": "summary",
  "workspace_path": "C:/work/project"
}

预期返回：
{
  "ok": true,
  "mode": "summary",
  "root_path": "C:/work/project",
  "content": "Workspace: C:/work/project\nDirectories: 18\nFiles: 64",
  "summary": {
    "directory_count": 18,
    "file_count": 64,
    "returned_entry_count": 0,
    "max_depth": 2,
    "max_entries": 300,
    "truncated": false
  }
}

title: 查看两层目录树
按文件名搜索
content:
需要搭配文本读取工具时，先用 find 模式定位可能要读取的文件路径。

输入参数：
{
  "mode": "find",
  "workspace_path": "C:/work/project",
  "query": "config",
  "max_depth": 5,
  "max_entries": 100
}

预期返回：
{
  "ok": true,
  "mode": "find",
  "content": "[F] src/config.py\n[F] config/app.json",
  "entries": [
    {
      "path": "src/config.py",
      "name": "config.py",
      "type": "file",
      "depth": 2,
      "size_bytes": 2400
    }
  ]
}
